card.name: Neuromuscular blocker labels, small linking words
card.fires_on: Small punctuation and linking words (of, and, comma, period, For) inside neuromuscular blocker and reversal-agent label text, such as rocuronium, atracurium, sugammadex and TOF monitoring.

modes.label: Linking words and punctuation
modes.description: Small words or marks between drug names or recovery phrases in muscle-relaxant text.
modes.example: pancuronium, atracurium<< and>> vecuronium interactions have been studied.

modes.label: Inside numbers and drug names
modes.description: Decimal points, spaces in ranges, or the middle of the name sugammadex.
